faq.a: A classic manicure takes about 45 min, a gel polish manicure about 1.5 h. A classic pedicure takes about an hour, a smart pedicure with polish about 1.5 h.
Nothing special: come with clean hands and no hand cream. If you have polish from another salon, mention it in the booking comment so I can plan time for removal (200 CZK).

faq.q: Should I remove old polish at home?
faq.a: Better not: removing it yourself can easily damage the nail plate. I'll take it off carefully and your nails will be ready for a new finish.

faq.q: How do I care for the finish?
faq.a: Wear gloves for dishes and cleaning, apply cuticle oil daily and don't use your nails as tools. That way the finish stays fresh for longer.

faq.q: How often should gel polish be renewed?
faq.a: Usually every 3–4 weeks: the nail grows out and the shape needs refreshing. If the finish still holds well, it's your call.
Message me on Instagram: repairing one nail costs 50–70 CZK, and we'll find the nearest free slot.
Yes. Message me as early as possible so I can offer the slot to someone else.
